title: Gemma 4 12B on Apple Silicon via MLX (mlx-vlm): 256K ctx, vision (OCR/UI/charts), native audio, function calling, local
summary: Apple Silicon M-series. Gemma 4 12B (dense, unified multimodal). Runtime: MLX (mlx-vlm). Métricas: 256K context; dynamic resolution vision; native audio ASR + speech translation. Uso: local multimodal agents, vision, voice, function calling on Mac. Límite: Requires uv pip install -U mlx-vlm; optimized specifically for Apple Silicon. Por qué importa: Official partnership optimization for the new encoder-free Gemma 4 12B. One-command install gives full multimodal (text/image/audio interleaved) + thinking mode + agents locally on M-series without heavy encoders.
